acceptance.given: A pinned source result and its current snapshot identities are available.

oracle.expected: Fresh replay evidence records the same terminal semantic verdict as the pinned result after identity reconstruction.
forbidden: Fresh replay reports a different terminal verdict as reproduced.
Assistant prose is used as proof of reproduction.
oracle.observable: Machine-verifiable replay receipt containing reconstructed binding identities and equal pinned/fresh terminal verdicts.

acceptance.then: The replay receipt proves terminal semantic verdict equality from fresh execution evidence.
acceptance.when: Verification first reconstructs the original binding identity, then launches a fresh replay with that same identity and compares terminal verdicts.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Mutate the fresh replay terminal verdict while retaining the pinned verdict and assert reproduction is rejected.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reconstruct the original binding identity before replay and require fresh replay terminal verdict equality; reject mismatched identity or verdict.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay receipt schema and fail-closed terminal categories.

slice_hint.state_transition: pinned result -> identity reconstructed -> fresh replay -> equal verdict or stale/failure
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Exit success only when reconstructed binding identity matches the pinned identity and fresh terminal verdict equals the pinned verdict in machine-readable evidence.

acceptance.given: An external process or aggregate executes under an applicable bounded time or output budget.

oracle.expected: When the budget is exhausted, the execution terminates with an unsuccessful status and coverage is not reported complete.
forbidden: A budget-exhausted execution is reported as successful.
Budget exhaustion removes required coverage obligations.
oracle.observable: Process or aggregate receipt containing budget-exhausted terminal category and unsuccessful verdict.

acceptance.then: The bounded execution has a deterministic unsuccessful terminal outcome.
acceptance.when: The configured time or output budget is reached during execution and the resulting receipt is evaluated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run a bounded process fixture that exceeds its time or output budget and assert the terminal result is unsuccessful.

affected_subjects: Budgeted external process or aggregate execution
slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce bounded time/output execution with deterministic unsuccessful terminal state on budget exhaustion without reducing required coverage.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain existing terminal category compatibility while mapping timeout/output exhaustion to unsuccessful.

slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Any elapsed-time or output-limit exhaustion yields a deterministic unsuccessful terminal receipt and leaves coverage incomplete.

acceptance.given: A verdict is evaluated from the current repository state and execution outputs.

oracle.expected: A machine-verifiable receipt binds current source identity and real execution evidence as the verdict basis.
forbidden: Assistant prose is the sole verdict basis.
A verdict is accepted without source identity or execution evidence.
oracle.observable: Validation receipt containing source hash/identity, command execution evidence, and verdict derivation fields.

acceptance.then: The verdict is independently reproducible from source and execution evidence.
acceptance.when: The validator inspects the receipt during acceptance evaluation and checks its source identity and real-process evidence bindings.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Remove source or execution bindings from a verdict receipt and provide only assistant prose; acceptance must reject it.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require verdict derivation to bind current source identity and attributable real execution evidence; prose cannot authorize or substantiate acceptance.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep receipt fields backward compatible while requiring evidence bindings for validity.

slice_hint.state_transition: verdict produced -> source/execution bindings checked -> evidence-based acceptance or invalid
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Acceptance succeeds only if current source identity and real execution evidence are present and machine-verifiable; prose-only verdicts fail closed.

acceptance.given: An aggregate evaluation contains matrix evidence whose freshness check is stale.

oracle.expected: The aggregate is marked invalid and cannot be accepted due to stale matrix evidence.
forbidden: The aggregate remains valid or is accepted despite stale matrix evidence.
oracle.observable: Aggregate evaluation receipt with stale-evidence diagnostic and invalid terminal verdict.

acceptance.then: The aggregate transitions to invalid and acceptance is blocked.
acceptance.when: The aggregate evaluator performs its freshness check on matrix evidence and encounters stale identity or content.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Supply stale matrix evidence to aggregate evaluation and assert it emits invalid terminal status and blocks acceptance.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Invalidate aggregate evaluation whenever matrix evidence freshness is stale, preventing acceptance and preserving a diagnostic reason.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve aggregate verdict schema and existing stale diagnostic categories.

slice_hint.state_transition: aggregate evaluated with stale evidence -> stale detected -> invalid aggregate
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Aggregate acceptance is false whenever any matrix evidence item is stale, missing, or freshness-invalid.
